locationScenery.The Ozama Wharf: a stone river wharf below an old Spanish colonial city, fortress walls above, soldiers on the quay
locationScenery.The Cathedral Square: a hot stone square before the oldest cathedral in the Americas, deep shade under arcades, bells
locationScenery.The Customs House: a cool vaulted Spanish customs hall, ledgers, seals and an official who is in no hurry
locationScenery.The Rigging Lofts: long high sail lofts above a Spanish river wharf, canvas spread across the floor, needles and beeswax
locationScenery.The Lodging House: a shuttered Spanish lodging house above a river wharf, cool tiled rooms, a courtyard with a well
locationScenery.The Land Gate: a fortified land gate in a Spanish colonial city wall, guardhouse, shade, soldiers checking who goes up

npcs.name: Rodrigo Nieves
npcs.bio: Master of the rigging lofts on the Ozama, and the finest cutter of sails in the Indies. Spanish rig is built to cross an ocean rather than to potter between islands, which is why a suit of his canvas shortens every passage a ship makes afterwards. He knows exactly what kind of captain walks into a Spanish port to buy it, and he has never yet said so to a soldier.
npcs.personality: Courteous to the point of being unreadable, slow, and enormously good company once the business is settled. Asks no questions he does not want answered.
npcs.likes: good manners, patience, a captain who does not pretend to be something obvious
npcs.dislikes: being hurried, boasting, anyone who assumes he can be bought cheaply
npcs.attractedTo: self-possession, discretion, and nerve worn lightly
npcs.identity: an elegant, slightly stooped man in his fifties, lean and long-fingered, deeply tanned, close grey beard, canvas-callused hands and very good boots

npcs.name: Bernardo Salcedo
npcs.bio: Customs officer, and the man who reads a stranger's papers on the Ozama. Thorough, slow, and entirely aware that half of what crosses his desk is a lie — the question is only ever whether it is a lie he is obliged to notice.
npcs.personality: Ceremonious, unhurried, faintly weary. Gives a man every chance to correct himself before he writes anything down.
npcs.likes: correct documents, courtesy, an honest correction
npcs.dislikes: impatience, bribes offered clumsily, foreigners who assume he is stupid
npcs.identity: a fastidious man in his fifties, spare and upright, olive-skinned, thin grey moustache, black clothes immaculate in the heat

npcs.name: Ines Valdivia
npcs.bio: Keeps the lodging house above the wharf, and has done since her husband did not come back. Takes anyone who pays, asks nothing, and misses nothing at all.
npcs.personality: Warm, practical, unsentimental, and the first person in this city to notice that a guest is not what they claim.
npcs.likes: paying guests, quiet nights, being told the truth
npcs.dislikes: trouble brought into her house, pity, unpaid weeks
npcs.identity: a handsome woman in her forties, full-figured and broad-hipped, olive-skinned, black hair greying at the temples, always working
npcs.attractedTo: kindness shown to staff, honesty, and someone who can sit at a table and talk

npcs.name: Feliciano Arce
npcs.bio: A canon of the cathedral, which is the oldest in the Americas and the only building in this city everyone still takes seriously. Says mass, hears confession, and has heard a very great deal.
npcs.personality: Gentle, learned, mischievously funny in private. Genuinely difficult to shock and completely uninterested in politics.
npcs.likes: music, a good argument about anything, the cool of the nave
npcs.dislikes: cruelty, certainty, people who perform their piety
npcs.identity: a slight, scholarly man in his sixties, stooped and thin, pale for this city from a life indoors, close-cut white hair, ink-stained fingers

npcs.name: Pascual Herrera
npcs.bio: Sergeant of the garrison, responsible for the wharf gate, and the man who decides which strangers walk up into the city. Underpaid, bored, and considerably sharper than his post requires.
npcs.personality: Gruff, watchful, and dryly funny once he decides a person is not a problem. Notices everything and mentions almost none of it.
npcs.likes: a quiet watch, straight answers, tobacco
npcs.dislikes: evasion, drunk sailors, being lied to badly
npcs.identity: a solid, weathered man in his thirties, broad-chested and thick-armed, dark-skinned and sunburnt over it, a broken nose, uniform coat worn open
npcs.attractedTo: directness, nerve, and someone who does not treat him as furniture

npcs.name: Leonor Cabral
npcs.bio: Sells fruit and fish in the cathedral square and knows the movements of every ship, official and soldier in this city, because all of them walk past her twice a day.
npcs.personality: Sharp, funny, endlessly talkative, and far more observant than anyone who has bought an orange from her realises.
npcs.likes: a good morning's trade, gossip, being right about people
npcs.dislikes: being cheated, silence, soldiers who take without paying
npcs.identity: a wiry woman in her thirties, small and quick, dark-skinned, a colourful headcloth, bare arms and bare feet, gold at her ears
npcs.attractedTo: humour, generosity, and anyone who talks to her properly

npcs.name: Juana Ocampo
npcs.bio: Apothecary off the square, and the person this city goes to before it goes to a physician. Knows what grows here and what it does, which is knowledge the Spanish medical faculties do not have.
npcs.personality: Quiet, precise, and entirely confident. Corrects a physician without raising her voice.
npcs.likes: careful patients, good stock, being asked rather than told
npcs.identity: a composed woman in her forties, slim and neat, olive-skinned, black hair coiled, sleeves buttoned despite the heat
npcs.attractedTo: intelligence, calm, and people who listen to instructions

npcs.name: Tomas Balbuena
npcs.bio: Merchant, and one of the many in this city who trade quietly with the enemy because the Crown's ships come twice a year and people eat every day. Sells Spanish goods to anyone and buys foreign goods from anyone, carefully.
npcs.personality: Nervous, charming, quick to reassure, and constantly calculating who has seen him with whom.
npcs.likes: a discreet buyer, a quick settlement, being liked
npcs.dislikes: witnesses, delays, anyone who says his business out loud
npcs.identity: a well-fed man in his forties, soft and round-shouldered, olive-skinned and sweating, good clothes slightly too fine, rings

npcs.name: Catalina Nieves
npcs.bio: Cuts sail alongside her father in the rigging lofts and is already better at the fine work than he is. Runs the loft when he is not in it, which is often, and is entirely aware what sort of captain buys canvas here.
npcs.personality: Direct, confident, faintly impatient at being introduced as somebody's daughter. Talks about the work with real pleasure.
npcs.likes: a difficult cut done well, being taken on her own account, foreign ships
npcs.dislikes: being talked past, condescension, slow payment
npcs.identity: a strong young woman in her twenties, athletic and full-figured, olive-skinned, black hair braided out of the way, canvas-callused hands, sleeves cut off
npcs.attractedTo: competence, respect given without being asked for, and anyone who talks to her about the work

npcs.name: Ubaldo Serna
npcs.bio: Works a boat on the Ozama, carrying people and cargo between the wharf and whatever is anchored downstream. Knows the river, the tides, and precisely which officials are on which gate at which hour.
npcs.personality: Cheerful, incurious, and quietly for hire. Talks constantly about nothing and is careful never to say anything.
npcs.likes: a full boat, good weather, being tipped
npcs.identity: a lean, ropy man in his thirties, wiry and sun-blackened, bare-chested and barefoot, a straw hat falling apart
npcs.attractedTo: easy company, generosity, and people who do not pry
